tokens.name: ground
tokens.usage: Page background — warm paper in light, near-black graphite in dark.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Cards, answer blocks, source cards, menus and the query bar.

tokens.name: surface-sunken
tokens.usage: Wells: code, excerpt backgrounds, the track of relevance meters, table headers.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairlines between rows and around cards. Decorative only — never the sole boundary of a control.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Input and control borders; holds 3:1 on ground and surface.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text on ground, surface, surface-sunken, highlight-soft.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text: metadata, timestamps, page numbers, captions — on ground, surface, surface-sunken.

tokens.name: brand
tokens.usage: Verity teal. Primary actions, active tabs, citation numbers, 'Indexed' status; as text on ground, surface, surface-sunken or brand-soft.

tokens.name: brand-soft
tokens.usage: Tinted fills behind brand text: selected rows, citation chips, the brand badge.

tokens.name: on-brand
tokens.usage: Text and icons on a brand fill (the primary button label).

tokens.name: highlight
tokens.usage: Evidence lime. Marks the retrieved passage and the cited span; a fill only, never text. Pair with on-highlight.

tokens.name: highlight-soft
tokens.usage: Quiet highlighter behind matched terms inside long excerpts; ink text on it.

tokens.name: on-highlight
tokens.usage: Text on a highlight fill, in every theme.

tokens.name: warn
tokens.usage: Partial / processing states: 'Indexing', low-confidence answers; as text on the surfaces or warn-soft.

tokens.name: warn-soft
tokens.usage: Fill behind warn text.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Failures: ingestion errors, 'No sources found', destructive actions; as text on the surfaces or danger-soft.

tokens.name: danger-soft
tokens.usage: Fill behind danger text.

tokens.name: logo-bubble-1
tokens.usage: Logo: the first speech bubble. Brand teal on paper, mint on dark.

tokens.name: logo-bubble-2
tokens.usage: Logo: the second speech bubble. Ink on paper, paper on dark.

tokens.name: logo-wordmark
tokens.usage: Logo: the wordmark. The lens between the bubbles is always the highlight.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: Focus ring: 2px solid, offset 2px; ≥6:1 on every surface in both themes.

styles.name: display
styles.usage: Hero line on empty states and landing screens. One per screen.

styles.name: h1
styles.usage: Headlines on sign-in and other focused screens.

styles.name: question
styles.usage: The question heading above an answer.

styles.name: answer
styles.sample: Refunds are issued within 14 days of approval.
styles.usage: Generated answer text — slightly larger and looser than body for long reading.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Upload PDFs, DOCX or Markdown to start.
styles.usage: Default UI copy, excerpts, table cells.

styles.name: mono
styles.usage: IDs, chunk names, token counts, model names.

styles.name: score
styles.usage: Relevance scores and latencies, always tabular.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-label gaps, chip padding.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gaps inside a row of chips or badges.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Control padding, gaps between stacked lines in a card.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Card padding (compact), list row padding.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Card padding (answer card), gaps between cards.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Section spacing.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Page gutters on desktop, empty-state breathing room.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Badges, citation chips, inputs inside cards.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Buttons, source cards, document rows' hover fill.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Answer card and the query bar — the two hero surfaces.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Scope chips and the send button.

tokens.name: shadow-raised
tokens.usage: Answer card and query bar only. Other cards use a line border, no shadow.

tokens.name: shadow-pop
tokens.usage: Citation popovers and menus.
